name: Resource_CalculatePathHash
reviewer: smart-workflow runtime round 20 (typed paired capture review)
disassembly: 0x004B5B3F  0f be c9           movsx ecx, cl           ; signed byte
0x004B5B43  0f af c1           imul eax, ecx           ; acc *= (int8)c
semantics: Pure function of one NUL-terminated read-only string. acc starts at 1; for each byte the accumulator is incremented and multiplied by the sign-extended byte (32-bit wraparound), then the final accumulator is reduced modulo 0x3037 (12343) and returned in EAX. The empty string returns 1. No stores, no calls, no reads of global state other than the string itself. The caller cannot affect the result, so the contract is caller-independent.

candidate_implementation.semantic_note: engine/src/retail/sys/resource_lookup.cpp reproduces the same fold with an explicit unsigned multiply and a modulo; the compiler lowers the modulo to the reciprocal of 0x3037 (mov 0x53cff70b / mul / shifts) instead of retail's div, which is the same remainder for every 32-bit input.

runtime_contract.execution_status: executed on both sides for the level1 windowed scenario, but not promoted: no identical input string was observed on both sides, so the paired input->output relation was not compared.
runtime_contract.note: required_observables is exactly the typedState subset this review authorizes for 0x004B5B30. Fields named under recorded_but_not_compared are emitted by the probe and reported in the comparison evidence, but are properties of the input or of the caller, not of the contract, so they are not equality-compared: the hash is a pure input->output function and the view reset writes a fixed post-state. Input->output parity for the hash is established separately by the shared-input table (identical input strings observed on both sides with identical returns and identical expected values). Only scalar values, bit patterns, pointer classes, offsets and within-process relations are compared; no address is compared across processes. The probe emits explicit unavailable markers for any field it cannot read and never throws. reviewed_no_calls and reviewed_no_stores are static-review assertions (the reviewed bytes contain no call and no store instruction); their runtime corroboration is write_target_count=0 and input_string_unchanged_after_call=true.

limitations: One paired scenario only: retail level 1, windowed (arguments "window level1"), working directory Z:\Users\haseeb-mir\Downloads\IGI, one capture per side. Other levels, fullscreen mode, other command lines and other working directories were not captured.
This is runtime parity for the typed contract above, not VERIFIED status, and it does not claim that the whole game, its startup sequence or any other native is equivalent.

The candidate image is rebuilt by other agents while this work runs. The harness resolved the candidate symbols, verified every reviewed candidate callsite byte and staged the exact image whose SHA-256 is recorded here; a change between resolution and staging is refused.

Call counts differ by design: retail hashed 13426 paths in the observation window while the candidate hashed 1. The retail callers (Resource_CreateNode, Is_ResourceLoaded) and the candidate callers are the same two functions, but the candidate loads far fewer resources. The hash is a pure function, so the contract is the input->output mapping and it is compared over identical input strings rather than over equal call counts.
Only the first natural call on each side has a full typed record; every later call is summarized in the cumulative census (all returns equal the retail formula, all argument strings unchanged).

The census keeps at most 96 distinct input strings per side. Retail reached that cap (distinct_input_overflow=true), so the shared-input intersection is limited to the recorded set plus the first-call string, not every path retail hashed.
No raw pointer or address is compared across processes; the probe reads the argument string inside each process and reports its bytes.
